title: Your Pool Profits CRM
subtitle: System overview: funnels, sales pipeline, automations and every message

phases.title: New leads come in
phases.intro: Every call, form and text becomes a contact and a card in your pipeline, and your team is told right away.

phases.title: Follow up until they book
phases.intro: Short, friendly text sequences that keep you in front of the lead. Any reply stops the sequence and hands the conversation back to your team.

phases.title: Win and welcome the customer
phases.intro: When a job is won, the customer is welcomed and tagged correctly for everything that comes after.

phases.title: Reviews and reputation
phases.intro: Happy customers are asked for a Google review at the right moment; unhappy ones reach your team first.

phases.title: Keep customers and win them back
phases.intro: Reminders, upsells and win-back campaigns for past customers and old leads, plus clean-up for lost and spam contacts.

phases.title: Optional add-ons: ads and phone routing
phases.intro: Ready to switch on when you run Google Ads or want call routing for your main line. We connect them to your numbers and accounts.

Website Form Fill To Pipeline.title: Website form → New Lead
Website Form Fill To Pipeline.purpose: Someone fills out a quote or contact form on your website or landing pages. They become a New Lead card, the assigned team member gets an instant text with their details, and a follow-up task is created so nothing slips.

Answered Incoming Call To Pipeline.title: Answered call → New Lead
Answered Incoming Call To Pipeline.purpose: Every answered inbound call creates (or updates) a New Lead card. An hour later, a task reminds the team to listen to the recording and move the card to the right stage.

Missed Incoming Call To Pipeline.title: Missed call → New Lead
Missed Incoming Call To Pipeline.purpose: Same as A2 for calls you couldn't pick up (busy, no answer, voicemail). The contact is also tagged “missed call”, which starts the instant text-back (A4).

Missed New Lead - Initial SMS Follow-up.title: Missed-call text back
Missed New Lead - Initial SMS Follow-up.purpose: Texts the caller right away so they don't call the next company on the list. A reply within 30 minutes moves the card to In Communication; otherwise a second text goes out and the no-response follow-up (A6) starts.

Contact Created -> add owner.title: Assign every new contact
Contact Created -> add owner.purpose: Every new contact is assigned to your team member (the contact owner), so every alert and task reaches a real person.

No Response Follow-up.title: No-response follow-up
No Response Follow-up.purpose: For leads you haven't been able to reach. Up to 3 texts over about a week. Any reply stops the sequence and moves the card to In Communication; no reply after the last text moves it to Lost.

In Communication Stage.title: Nurture emails while you talk
In Communication Stage.purpose: Three short emails over four business days for leads who are talking with you but haven't booked yet. Off by default: In Communication is mainly a stage for your team to track live conversations, so nothing goes out unless you want it.

Appointment Confirmation/Reminders.title: Estimate confirmation and reminders
Appointment Confirmation/Reminders.purpose: When an estimate is booked on your calendar: the card moves to Scheduled, your team is alerted, and the customer gets a confirmation, a reminder the day before and a heads-up an hour before. Turn it on if you book estimates through the CRM calendar.

No-Show Follow-up.title: No-show follow-up
No-Show Follow-up.purpose: If a customer misses the appointment, the reminders stop and they get a text to reschedule. A reply moves them to In Communication; no reply after two texts moves them to Lost.

Quote Sent Follow-up.title: Quote follow-up
Quote Sent Follow-up.purpose: After you send a quote, a text follows up the next day and another two days later. A reply moves the card to In Communication; no reply moves it to Lost.

Won Stage.title: Welcome new customers
Won Stage.purpose: Runs when a card moves to any of the three Won stages. Weekly-service customers get a welcome email and a welcome text; repair/install and construction jobs are tagged and marked won. Contacts tagged “existing customer” are skipped, so loading your current customers never sends them a welcome.

branch_labels.Repairs / Installs: Won - One Time Repair or Install

Recurring Customer Stage.title: Mark recurring customers
Recurring Customer Stage.purpose: Tags the contact “recurring customer” and sets Client Type = Recurring, so reminders, filters and campaigns can target your active customers.

Post-Appointment Follow-up.title: How did the first visit go?
Post-Appointment Follow-up.purpose: An hour after a weekly customer is won, asks how the service went; either way the card moves to Recurring Customer. Optional, because the welcome messages (A11) already go out at that moment.

Review Request.title: Rating first, then the Google review
Review Request.status_note: ON once your Google review link is connected
Review Request.purpose: Some time after a job is won, the customer gets a text asking for a quick 1–5 rating. Happy customers (4–5) are sent your Google review link by text and email. A 1–3 alerts your team so you can make it right first. If they don't rate within 7 days, the review link goes out anyway.

flow.text: Waits after the job is won: 30 days (weekly service), 8 days (repair or install), 45 days (construction)
Then 14 more days, sent between 9am and 5pm
Waits up to 7 days for the rating

paths.label: Rated 4–5, or no rating after 7 days

Review Response - Positive.title: Thank-you for good reviews
Review Response - Positive.purpose: When a 4 or 5-star Google review comes in, the reviewer gets a personal thank-you text.

Review Response - Negative.title: Fast response to bad reviews
Review Response - Negative.purpose: When a review of 3 stars or less comes in, the contact is flagged high priority, gets an apology text offering a call, and your team gets an urgent task to call within 24 hours.

Monthly Service Reminder.title: Monthly service reminder
Monthly Service Reminder.purpose: 30 days after a customer becomes recurring, a text reminds them their service is coming up and invites special requests.

Filter Clean Reminder.title: Filter cleaning reminder
Filter Clean Reminder.purpose: About 75 days after a customer becomes recurring, an email lets them know their filter cleaning is coming up (sent on weekdays, during business hours).

Upsell Opportunity.title: Upsell after a visit
Upsell Opportunity.purpose: When your tech spots something worth fixing, tag the customer “upsell opportunity”: they get a text inviting a conversation, with one follow-up. A reply moves them to In Communication.

Reactivation Campaign - SMS.title: Win-back texts
Reactivation Campaign - SMS.purpose: Tag a list of past customers or old leads “reactivation” and they get 3 texts over a week. Afterwards they're tagged “do not remarket”, so nobody is hit twice.

Reactivation Campaign - Email.title: Win-back emails
Reactivation Campaign - Email.purpose: Runs alongside A20 with 3 emails over a week: a free inspection offer, why customers choose you, and a last note.

SMS Customer Reply to pipeline.title: Campaign replies → New Lead
SMS Customer Reply to pipeline.purpose: When someone from a win-back campaign texts back, they become a New Lead card, leave the campaign, and your team gets the reply by text and app notification.

Lost Stage.title: Lost lead: feedback and 90-day check-in
Lost Stage.purpose: Two business days after a card is marked Lost, the owner asks by email why they went with someone else. 90 days later, a check-in email asks how the other company is doing.

Spam Contact.title: Spam clean-up
Spam Contact.purpose: Moving a card to Spam tags the contact and turns on Do Not Disturb, so no automation ever texts them again.

AdWords Call In - New Lead.title: Google Ads calls
AdWords Call In - New Lead.purpose: For your Google Ads call tracking number: reports the call to Google Ads as a conversion, tags the lead, creates a New Lead card and sends a thank-you text 5 minutes later.
AdWords Call In - New Lead.trigger_note: A call comes in on your Google Ads tracking number (we connect it when your ads go live)

AdWords Form - New Lead.title: Google Ads landing page form
AdWords Form - New Lead.purpose: For the landing page used in your Google Ads: reports the conversion, alerts your team, creates the card and texts the lead right away. Until ads run, that same form feeds A1.

Adword Call - Conversion.title: Report won jobs to Google Ads
Adword Call - Conversion.purpose: When a lead becomes a weekly customer, reports a “won” conversion to Google Ads, so your campaigns optimize for paying customers instead of just calls.

Sequential Call Routing.title: Call routing for your main line
Sequential Call Routing.purpose: Rings your team one after the other and takes a voicemail if nobody answers, with call recording on. We set it up with your team's phones and your own greeting.
Sequential Call Routing.trigger_note: A call comes in on your main business line (once we connect it)

flow.text: Plays your voicemail greeting and records the caller's message

stages.🆕 New Lead: Every new call, form and text reply lands here.
stages.No Response - Follow Up: You tried and couldn't reach them. Starts the 3-text follow-up.
stages.💬 In Communication: You're talking with them. Nothing is sent unless you turn on A7.
stages.💰 Quote Sent: Quote is out; the follow-up starts.
stages.🔄 Recurring Customer: Active customer on a regular schedule.
stages.❄ Not Qualified Stage: Outside your area or not a fit. Nothing is sent.
stages.❌ Lost: Went with someone else or stopped answering.
stages.🚫 Spam: Spam or robocall. Messaging is turned off.

forms.Landing Page - Optin Form: Quote request on the main landing page → A1 (A26 when Google Ads run).
forms.Service Page - Contact Form: Contact form on the service pages → A1.
forms.Appointment Booking Form: Details collected when someone books on your calendar.
forms.Client Onboarding Form: New-customer intake: pool details, access, preferences.
forms.Post-Visit Status Form: After-visit report for a service call.
forms.NPS Form: The 1–5 rating page customers open from the rating text (A14).

custom_values.Friendly Business Name: Your name as customers know it, used in every message.
custom_values.Legal Business Name: Legal name for the website footer and consent text.
custom_values.Owner First Name: Signs the emails and the missed-call text.
custom_values.Business Phone: The number customers are told to call.
custom_values.A2P Verification Number: Your texting number (registered with the carriers).
custom_values.Business Email: Shown on the website and in emails.
custom_values.Service Area: Cities you serve, used on the website.
custom_values.Google Review Link: Where happy customers are sent to review you.
custom_values.Logo URL: Your logo on pages and emails.
custom_values.NPS Survey Link: The rating page used by A14 (set automatically).
